content: Asab okkolore tobolig goitto defeṛar
Bade he barozon asabore ekottoro gori ḍaikke edde hibaye hitarare har bod ruhor uwore edde biyaram bala goribolla šokti edde kemota diye.
Ar Allar raijjor tobolig goribolla edde biyaram aram goribolla Isaye hitarare faṭai diye.
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Tũwara fõtolla kissu no loiyo, laṛi otóba gaṭṭi, hána otóba ṭĩya kissu no loiyo. Findibar fušak o dui zura no loiyo.
Ar tũwara ze górot zo, he fara sari no zogoi foijjonto he górot taikko.
Zodi mainše tũwarare no gose, he šohor sari zaibar šomot tũwarar ṭengor tolar dul zari felaiyo, zene hine hitarar berudde goba oi tiya."

content: Toi sahabi okkol henttu giyegoi edde fara fara zai Allar raijjor kušir hóbor tobolig goijje edde biyaramma okkolore aram goijje.
Badša Herud edde Isa
Badša Herude Isaye zin zin gorer hin beggun fuinne kintu hite honnan biššaš goribo buzi uṛi no fajjil. Kiyollabulihoile kiye kiye hoito Yahya mora okkolor butottu uṛi giyegoi.
Ar kiye kiye hoito Eliyase deha diye, ar kiye kiye hoito, furan hailla nobi okkolor butottu ekzon zinda oi uiṭṭe.
Ar Herude hodde, "Ãi to Yahyar mata haṛi felailam, kintu iba honnuwa zar babute endilla hota funazar." Hetolla badša Herude Isare saibolla kušiš goijje.
Isaye fãs hazar manušore hána diye
Bade asab okkole zin zin goijje, firi aiyore hitara hinore kulasagori Isare zanaiye. Tarfore Isaye hitarare fũwati loi Betsaida farar ḍake ek nizam zagat giye.

Kintu mainše he hóbor zani fariyore hitara Isar fisa loiye. Toi Isaye hitarare rahamotor sãte goisse edde hitarar hãse Allar raijjor babute hota hoiye. Ar zara aram oibar dorhar aššil hitarare aram goijje.

Tarfore din šeš oi aišše, ar he barozon asabe Isar hãse zai hodde: "Õne ei manuš okkolore bidai do, zene itara sairo mikka farat, geramot zai rait haṛai fare edde hána fani tuwai loi fare, kiyollahoile ãra aside zagagan kissu naide zaga."
Kintu Isaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Tũwara hitarare hána do!"

content: Asab okkole hodde, "Fãswa ruṭi edde duwa mas sara ãrar hãse ar kissu nai. Ar ki ãra zai edun manušolla haiddo kini ani faijjum?"
(Heṛe onumanik fãs hazar furuš manuš aššil.) Hetunot Isaye sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Itara beggunore fõnzašzon fõnzašzon grup gori buwai do."

content: Sahabi okkole hen goijje, beggunore buwai diye.
Tarfore Isaye he fãswa ruṭi edde duwa mas loi asmanor uzu suk tuli hinolla Allare šukuriya zanaiye edde hinore bangi sahabi okkolore diye, mainšore baṛi dibolla.
Toi beggune feṭbori hána háiye. Tarfore hitara zin hái bade guragara basi roiye hinore dola gori baro barang hána oiye.
Fitore Isare Allar Mosi šikar gorer
Isaye ek bar ekela munazat goredde šomot sahabi okkol o hibar fũwati heṛe aššil. Isaye hitarare fusar goredde:

content.text: "Ãi honnuwa, ei babute mainše ki ho?"

content: Hitara zuwab diye, "Torikotor gusol doya Yahya, kintu kiye kiye ho nobi Eliyas, ar kiye, beši agor nobi okkolor butottu ek nobi uṛigiyegoi."
Isaye hitarare fusar goredde:

content.text: "Kintu tũwara ki ho, ãi honnuwa?"

content: Fitore hodde, "Õne Allar he Mosi."
Hetunot Isaye hitarare ei hota honokiyore no hoibolla hũšiyari diye edde mana goijje.
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Adomor Futottu beši duk buggora foribo. Ar murobbi okkol, ḍõr imam edde alem okkole hibare batil goribo edde mari felaibo. Ar tin dinor din hibattu morattu uṛizagoi foribo."

content: Isar fise lowa
Toi hibaye beggunore hodde:

content.text: "Honokiye zodi ãr fise aito issa gore, hite nizore ošikar gorok edde hite fotti din nizor duk hoštore bordaš gori ãr fise fise aiyok.
Kiyollahoile ze honokiye hitar nizor foran basaito sa, hite hiyan haraibo. Kintu ze honokiye ãlla boli hitar nizor foran hara, hite hiyan basaibo.
Hitar ki lab oiye, zodi šara duniyai hama, kintu nizore harai fele otóba nošto gori fele?

Kiyollahoile ze honokiye ãre edde ãr kalamore mainšor munttu šorome ošikar gore. Adomor Fut zehon nizor, edde fobitro firista okkol edde Bafor tozolli loi aibo, hẽtte hibaye o he manuš okkolore ošikar goribo.
"Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, eṛe tũwarar butore en hozon ase zara Allar raijjo no deke foijjonto hitara hono mote moutor fiyala no fibo."

content: Isa Mosir ruf
In okkol hoi ek hafta bade, Isaye munazat goribolla Fitor, Yuhanna, Yakub, itarare loi ek faharor uwore giye.
Munazat goribar šomot Isar mukor siyara bodoli giyegoi edde hibar fušak ujjol dola oi giyegoi.
Ar so, duizon manuš, Musa edde Eliyas, hitara Isa loi hota howa šuru goijje.
Hitara keramoti zak zomok loi deha diye edde Zeruzalemot Isaye ze moutor muamui oito zar, hitara he befare hotabatra hoiye.
He šomot Fitor edde hitar sãti okkol bári gumot aššil. Hitara seton oi Isar keramot edde oi duizon manuš zara Isar fũwati tiyai taikke hitarare deikke.

He duizon Isar hãsottu zargoide šomot Isare Fitore hodde: "Huzur, ãra eṛe aside bala oiye. Ãra tinnan bãša banai, ekkan õnolla, ekkan Musalla, ar ekkan Eliyasolla." (Kintu Fitore asole ki hor hin hite nize o no zane.)
Fitore hen hodde šomot ekkan miyula ai hitarar uwore saiya oiye. Hitara zẽtte miyular butore oiye, hẽtte hitara beši ḍoraiye.
Ar he miyular butottu endilla ek abaz funa giye, "Iba ãr fut, he basai gora, hibar hota fuinno."
Abaz oi mottor Isare ekela deha giye. Ar hitara suf gori taikke, zin zin sahabi okkole dekkil hin he šomot honokiyore no ho.
Isaye ek bute faiya fuware aram goijje
Tarfordin zehon hitara he faharottu lami aišše, bout mainše Isa loi deha goijje.
Ar so, zamor butottu ekzone guzori hodde, "Huzur, aroz gorir, ãr fuwawar uzu suk tuli so, kiyollahoile ite šude ãr lehar ek fut.
So, ek ruhuye itare hamela gorer, ar atikka kiskisai uṛe. He ruhuye itare musori dore, henot ite muk bai fena bair gore, ar ruhuye itare zal zal gori kub hošto di erizagoi.
Ãi õnor sahabi okkolore foriyad goijjilam, zene hitara ibare sarai de, kintu hitara no fare."
Toi Isaye zuwabe hodde:

content.text: "Oh obiššaši edde bonḍor dol! Ar hotokal ãi tũwarar fũwati takiyum edde tũwarare bordaš goriyum? Tor futore loi eṛe ai!"

content: He fuwawa aiyerde hen šomot oi bod ruhuye hitare felai diye edde hora gori musori doijje. Kintu Isaye he napak ruhure dõk diyore fuwaware aram goijje. Toi hitare bafor hãse firai diye.

Henot beggune Allar he mohimar šokti deki tajjuf oiye. Isaye abar nizor motor babute hor (Moti 17:22–23; Mark 9:30–32) Toi hár manuš okkol Isaye goijjede hamot tajjuf oiyede šomot, Isaye sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ei šob hota mon di funo! Kiyollahoile Adomor Futore manuš okkolor hatot tuli diya oibo."

content: Kintu hitara he hota buzi no fare, edde he hotar mani hitarattu gufon raka oiye, zenneki hitara buzi uṛi no fare, ar he babute Isattu fusar goitte o hitara ḍoraiye.
Ḍõr hone
Sahabi okkol hone beggunottuwaro ḍõr hiyan loi hitarar butore hota haṛa haṛi oiye.
Isaye hitarar monor baf buzi fariyore ek gura fuware loi hibar ḍake tiyagoraiye.
Toi sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Ze honokiye ãr name ei gura fuwaware gose, hite ãre gose. Ar ze honokiye ãre gose, hite hibare gose ze ãre defeṛaiye. Kiyollahoile ze tũwarar butore beggunottuwaro šoṛo, hite oilde dõr."

content: Bade Yuhannaye hodde, "Ustad, õnor name ekzon mainše but saradde dekkilam, hite ãrar dolot node hetolla buli ãra hitare mana goijjilam."
Kintu Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara hitare mana no goijjo! Kiyollahoile ze tũwarar bifokke no hitede tũwarar fokke ase."

content: Sameriya farar mainše Isare no gose
Ar zehon Isare uwore tuli loi zaibar ṭaim hãse aišše, hetunot Isa Zeruzalemor mikka zaibolla ek mone ereda gori felaiye.
Ar Isaye zaibar age hóborguwa okkolore defeṛaiye. Ar hitara zai Sameri okkolor farat góille, Isalla entezam gori farefan.
Isaye Zeruzalem zaibo ereda goijje buli heṛiyar manuš okkole Isare no gose.
Hendilla deki Isar sahabi Yakub edde Yuhannaye fusar goredde, "Malik, õne ki issa goro, Eliyase zendilla goijje hendilla ãra hoi, asmanottu oin lami ai itarare dongšo gori felok?"
Kintu Isaye hitarar mikka muk firai dõk diye edde hodde, tũwara no zano ne, tũwarare hon ruh loi banaiye? Adomor Futore manušor zibon dongšo goribolla faṭa oiyede no, kintu uddar goribolla.
Tarfore hitara oinno ekkan farat giyegoi.
Isare manile dam diya fore
Hitara fõt bai zadde hen šomot ekzon manuše Isare hodde, "Õne zeṛe zo ãi o õnor fũwati heṛe zaiyum."
Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Šiyal okkolottu gãt ase edde asmanor faikottu baha ase, kintu Adomor Fute mata rakibar hono zaga nai."

content: Isaye ar ekzonore hodde:

content.text: "Ãr fisa lo."

content: Kintu hite hodde: "Huzur, age ãr bafore dohon gorai aito do."
Isaye hitare hodde:

content.text: "Mora okkole mora okkolore dohon gora ok, kintu tui zai Allar raijjor tobolig gor."

content: Ar ekzone Isare hodde, "Malik, ãi õnor fisa loiyum, kintu age ãre ãr góror manuš okkolottu bidai loi aito do."
Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ze honokiye naholor kuṛi dori fis mikka firisa hite Allar raijjor laikka oi no fare."
